commands:
#!/bin/sh
set -u
cd /home/patrick/work/i559 || exit 1
attempt=0
while test ! -f build.exit && test "$attempt" -lt 80; do sleep 3; attempt=$((attempt+1)); done
test -f build.exit && test "$(cat build.exit)" = 0 || exit 2
umask 077
mkdir /tmp/q559t1 /tmp/q559t1/r || exit 3
python3 tools/diagnostics/check_socket_paths.py --socket /tmp/q559t1/r/putgd/session.sock > /tmp/q559t1/socket-preflight.json || exit 4
export TMPDIR=/tmp/q559t1 XDG_RUNTIME_DIR=/tmp/q559t1/r
export QT_QPA_PLATFORM=offscreen QT_QPA_PLATFORMTHEME=generic
unset DISPLAY WAYLAND_DISPLAY XDG_CURRENT_DESKTOP XDG_SESSION_DESKTOP XDG_SESSION_TYPE
export DBUS_SESSION_BUS_ADDRESS=unix:path=/nonexistent/q559-no-session-bus
nice -n 10 ctest --preset dev -R '^(edit_operations_integration|editor_job_integration|gui_history_view|gui_tray|operations_contract|history_contract)$' --output-junit /tmp/q559t1/results.xml > /tmp/q559t1/ctest.log 2>&1
code=$?
printf '%s\n' "$code" > /tmp/q559t1/ctest.exit
exit "$code"
